title: A Father's Blessing
content:
For a few long moments...

Silence filled the entrance.

Yashwanth stood frozen, unable to understand why Siddu had brought Varsha to his father's house.

His heartbeat grew louder with every passing second.

Then...

His father slowly turned around.

The smile on his face faded, and without saying a single word, he quietly walked inside.

Yashwanth's heart sank.

His hands began to tremble.

"He knows..."

"He knows everything..."

"He didn't approve of us..."

Fear tightened around his heart.

Unable to control himself, he hurried toward Siddu.

"What happened?"

"What did you tell my father?"

"Why did he suddenly become so serious?"

His voice trembled with every word.

"I knew this would happen..."

"He'll never accept our love."

"Why..."

"Why did this have to happen to us?"

Before Siddu could answer...

Varsha gently stepped forward.

She softly held Yashwanth's hand.

"Yash..."

"Calm down."

But Yashwanth gently pulled his hand away.

"How can I calm down?"

"My father just walked away after seeing you."

"He didn't say a single word."

"And..."

He looked straight into Varsha's eyes.

"Why aren't you worried?"

"Why don't I see even a little fear on your face?"

Instead of answering immediately...

Varsha smiled.

She slowly stepped closer until they were standing face to face.

Looking into his anxious eyes, she softly said,

"Because..."

"Your father has already given us his blessing."

Yashwanth stared at her in complete disbelief.

"W-What...?"

"My father accepted our love?"

"Then..."

"How...?"

A gentle smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"Who told you that your father rejected your love?"

Yashwanth stood speechless.

"I..."

"I just assumed..."

Siddu chuckled softly.

"Sometimes..."

"The battles we fear the most exist only in our own minds."

"You judged your father's answer before giving him the chance to speak."

Yashwanth slowly turned toward Varsha once again.

"If my father accepted us..."

"Then how did it happen?"

Varsha's eyes shifted toward Siddu.

A smile of gratitude spread across her face.

"It was Siddu."

"He convinced your father."

Yashwanth looked at his best friend in astonishment.

"You...?"

Siddu simply smiled.

"We can talk about that later."

"For now..."

He looked at both of them with genuine happiness.

"You've both waited long enough."

"This moment belongs to the two of you."

"Go..."

"Spend it together."

He gently patted Yashwanth's shoulder before turning toward the door.

"Where are you going?" Yashwanth asked.

Without turning back, Siddu smiled.

"My work here is finished."

"The rest of this day..."

"Belongs to both of you."

With those words...

He quietly walked away.

Yashwanth stood there for a few moments, watching his best friend disappear into the distance.

A smile slowly spread across his face.

Then he turned toward Varsha.

Tears of happiness had already begun to gather in her eyes.

He gently held both of her hands.

"Finally..."

"I can call you mine."

"Thank you..."

"For believing in me."

"For waiting for me."

"And..."

"For loving me."

Varsha's eyes shimmered with emotion.

"I'll always love you, Yash."

Unable to hold back their happiness any longer...

They embraced each other tightly.

Months of fear...

Countless sleepless nights...

And endless unanswered questions...

All melted away in a single embrace.

At that moment...

They weren't celebrating a wedding.

They were celebrating the victory of love over fear.

And somewhere in the distance...

A quiet smile appeared on Siddu's face.

Watching his friend's happiness from afar...

He silently walked away,

Knowing that sometimes...

The greatest joy in life comes from becoming the reason someone else smiles.
